game: TB @ LA Week 12 2025, kickoff 2025-11-23 20:20 ET, LA -7, total 49.5, SoFi dome

script.base: Books have LA leading at home in a dome: implied totals LA 28.2 / TB 21.2 on a 49.5 total, so a one-score Rams lead by the second half rather than a 40-point shootout. LA closes with Kyren Williams (51 carries, 278 rush yards in weeks 9-11, about 60% of RB carries next to Blake Corum's 34/124). Tampa, as a 7-point dog, throws more — Emeka Egbuka (31 targets, 285 air yards L3) and Cade Otton (22 targets, 150 yards) — and the TB run game (Sean Tucker 40/201, Rachaad White 33/124) is trimmed but not erased unless the lead gets to two scores.
script.flip1: Tampa hangs around or leads. Baker Mayfield is +0.24 EPA/dropback when not blitzed and LA blitzes only 27%, so a no-blitz script lets TB stay on schedule, keep Tucker and White on the field, and force LA to throw (Puka Nacua 22 targets / 234 yards L3, Davante Adams 23 targets). Kyren's late clock-killing carries never fully arrive.
script.flip2: LA blows it open early. Kyren's late snaps get cut for Corum (last4 rush yards 37, 58, 56, 10), Tampa abandons the run so Tucker/White rush lines die, and Egbuka/Otton/Tez Johnson pick up garbage targets. Haason Reddick is already out, so this flip is about scoreboard, not a sudden LA pass-rush collapse.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game report only; inactives (~90 min pre-kick) are not in the pack. TB RB Bucky Irving Out (shoulder): L3 carries already sit with Tucker 40/201 (5.0 YPC) and White 33/124 (3.8 YPC), plus Mayfield 5/39 and J. Williams 4/11 — Tucker is next man up, not a zero-touch backup. TB G Ben Bredeson Out (hamstring): pressure up, rush efficiency down, more quick throws, which hurts Tucker/White yards per carry and helps Otton/White catches, not deep Egbuka air yards (285 L3). TB LB Haason Reddick Out (ankle) and LB Markees Watts Questionable (hand): LA's edge sees a backup, a small boost to Kyren and to time-to-throw. TB CB Jamel Dean Out (hip) and CB Benjamin Morrison Questionable (hamstring): LA WRs face a thinner secondary; TB allows 9.29 YPA in the middle. TB WR Chris Godwin Jr. Questionable (fibula) and already absent from the L3 target tree (Egbuka 31, Otton 22, Tez Johnson 14, Sterling Shepard 11), so a sit is mostly priced into recent usage; if he plays, those shares compress. LA WR Xavier Smith Questionable (concussion), only 6 targets / 34 yards L3 — if out, crumbs to Nacua/Adams/Terrance Ferguson, not a primary-line mover. Sources: pack injury report and weeks-8/10/11 and weeks-9/10/11 usage.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack, so shell is unconfirmed. Team proxies: LA blitz rate 27%, TB blitz rate 39%. Cannot map Egbuka, Otton, Nacua or Adams to a named zone defender.
matchup.pressure: LA blitzes only 27%. Mayfield is -0.21 EPA/dropback vs blitz and +0.24 vs no blitz, so Tampa's dropback edge exists if LA stays out of blitz; when LA does blitz, deep yards should die and checkdowns (Otton, White) rise. Separate from blitz rate, Bredeson out raises Tampa pressure risk. TB blitzes 39%, but LA is +0.17 EPA/db vs blitz and +0.23 vs none — not blitz-fragile. Reddick out further lowers the pass rush Tampa can actually bring.
matchup.bleeds: LA defense (10 games): rush 3.91 YPC, 23 runs of 10+, 27 passes of 20+ for 388 yards. YPA left 7.87 (149 att), middle 5.98 (82), right 5.69 (130) — stout on the run and in the middle/right, softest to the offensive left. TB defense (10 games): rush 4.25 YPC, 20 runs of 10+, 37 passes of 20+ for 364 yards. YPA left 6.46 (125), middle 9.29 (66), right 8.11 (147) — bleeds the middle, the right, and explosives.
matchup.overlap: TB's top option Egbuka (downfield: 285 air yards on 31 targets L3) does not attack LA's weak spot; LA is tighter in the middle and right and has allowed only 27 explosives in 10 games, and Bredeson out cuts deep shots. That is a weak overlap, so no Egbuka rec-yards leg at 62.5 (L3 190 yards, last4 58/35/115/40). The real overlap is LA's Nacua (168 air, 234 yards L3) and Adams (322 air but only 138 yards) into a Dean-less TB secondary that allows 9.29 YPA in the middle — but Nacua 91.5 and Adams 56.5 sit above L3 averages (78 and 46), so no receiving leg. Rush overlap used instead: Kyren into TB's 4.25 YPC (good); Tucker into LA's 3.91 YPC (bad — the 25.5 number has to do the work).

form: Avoiding season averages. TB L3 (weeks 8, 10, 11): Tucker 40/201 after Irving was already out of that sample; last4 rush yards 4, 42, 53, 106 — the 4 is the pre-role floor, the last three clear 25.5 easily. White last4 rush 38, 35, 38, 51 against a 38.5 line, L3 41.3 ypg, so he is at the number not through it. Egbuka L3 63.3 rec ypg vs a 62.5 line; Otton L3 50 vs 40.5 but last4 65/40/82/28; Tez Johnson L3 30.3 vs a 42.5 line; Shepard L3 27.3 vs 29.5. LA L3 (weeks 9-11): Kyren 51/278 (5.45 YPC, 92.7 ypg) with last4 rush 54, 114, 73, 91 — three of four over 69.5, one miss at 54. Corum 34/124, last4 rush 37/58/56/10, a real committee not a pure backup. Nacua last4 rec yards 28, 95, 64, 75 vs 91.5 (L3 78). Adams last4 35, 60, 77, 1 on 322 air yards L3 — explosive air, unstable yards. Higbee last4 19, 13, 33, 23 vs 24.5, splitting with Colby Parkinson (9 targets L3). No similar-defense charting beyond the 10-game team YPC/YPA splits.

Dog TB should throw more, which lifts WR/TE/RB targets and cuts Tucker/White rush attempts. Total 49.5 is high enough for volume, not a defensive slog. Dome, so no weather drag on that script.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Kyren: Corum took the second-half closer the way a 34-carry L3 teammate can, LA never led late so the 28.2 implied total showed up through Nacua and Adams instead of the run, and the 54-yard game in his last four repeated against a front that only needed to hold him under 70. Tucker: the game was flip2 by the second quarter, Tampa abandoned the run, White got the passing-down touches (10 targets L3), and LA's 3.91 YPC defense plus Bredeson out turned 6 carries into the 4-yard floor already on his card. That counter-case is why both are leans, not strongs. It is not stronger than Kyren's favorite-script plus 4.25 YPC matchup, or than Tucker's 40-carry role versus a 25.5 stand-in, so neither leg is dropped. A late Godwin or Morrison inactive would not directly flip these two rush legs; a surprise Irving active would kill Tucker and is not indicated (he is Out).
slip_story: Partial stack only, candidates not a bet. Kyren rush over belongs to the favorite-runs-the-clock story (LA 28.2, TB 4.25 YPC, Reddick out). Tucker rush over is the Irving-out sleeper and needs Tampa within a score long enough for 8 carries — it fits a competitive first half then an LA close, and it dies in the blowout flip. Do not add White rush over, a total under, or Egbuka/Otton/Nacua overs to this pair; those need a different script. No TDs, no receptions, no passing yards. Re-check at inactives; prices were never available to shop.
